acquisition method: The mass spectrometer was operated in the data-dependent mode.
alkylation reagent: subsequently alkylated in 50 mM iodoacetamide (IAA) for 50 min in the dark at room temperature.
alkylation concentration: subsequently alkylated in 50 mM iodoacetamide (IAA) for 50 min in the dark at room temperature.
cleavage agent: Digestion was performed with Lys-C (Wako 125-05061) (1% w:w enzyme:substrate) for 3 hours at 37°C, followed by addition of trypsin (Worthington) (1% w:w enzyme:substrate) for overnight digestion.
enrichment method: 3 mg Titansphere TiO2 beads (10 µm; GL-Sciences 5020 75010) were added per 500 µg peptides for 15 min shaking incubation at room temperature.
fractionation method: High pH reverse phase chromatographic separation

High pH reverse phase chromatographic separation was performed on a Agilent Zorbax 300 extend – C18 column (4.6 X 150 mm, 3.5 μm) using a 21 min stepped linear gradient of 0.5-40% solvent B (acetonitrile) against solvent A (H2O; 0.1% NH2O) and 40-85% solvent B against solvent A with a flow rate of 0.4 ml/min.
fragmentation method: The 10 most abundant ions were selected for fragmentation using higher-energy collisional dissociation (HCD) and dynamically excluded for 30 seconds.
instrument: Samples were resuspended in 0.1% FA and run on a LTQ Orbitrap Velos mass spectrometer (Thermo Scientific) coupled to a cHiPLC-Nanoflex chromatography system (Eksigent).
labeling: Stable Isotope Labeling by Amino acids in Cell culture (SILAC)

By combining Stable Isotope Labeling by Amino acids in Cell culture (SILAC) and phosphoproteomic analysis, we mapped cell-specific changes in protein phosphorylation that were triggered by contact between breast cancer cells and endothelial cells.
reduction reagent: After buffer exchange to 40 mM ABC, proteins were reduced in 20 mM dithiothreitol (DTT), 40 mM ABC for 45 min and subsequently alkylated in 50 mM iodoacetamide (IAA) for 50 min in the dark at room temperature.
reduction concentration: After buffer exchange to 40 mM ABC, proteins were reduced in 20 mM dithiothreitol (DTT), 40 mM ABC for 45 min and subsequently alkylated in 50 mM iodoacetamide (IAA) for 50 min in the dark at room temperature.
